name: sig_carve
description: A signature scan: find where known file headers (magic bytes) occur in a binary file, in one pass over it, and return every offset with a short preview. It carves nothing and estimates no size: a hit is where the bytes occur, not a file, so cut a decisive hit with file_carver (or read it in place) and check it with a parser of that format. Each header is found once, at its true offset, whatever the read size; an unknown signature name is an error, not an empty result. SCCA hits name candidate_start (the hit minus 4). The answer says which file and what range were scanned. The file is read as given: an E01 or other container is its container bytes, not the disk inside.

path.description: Path to the binary file to scan

context.description: Preview bytes from each hit (0 to 4096, default 64)

max_hits.description: Hits returned inline per signature (default 500); every hit is in all_results when there are more

window_bytes.description: Read block size (16 to 256 MiB, default 8 MiB); results do not depend on it
